title: Rooming-List Block Cut-Off Release — Group Room Blocks
content:
At the cut-off date of a Group Room Blocks contract, room nights held for the group are released to the hotel's general inventory.

### Scope and effect

This policy settles the cut-off release of a block whose attendees reserve by rooming list, the rooming-list reservations being held on the organiser's profile; a block whose attendees call in individually is outside this policy and keeps the release of every held room night not yet reserved by an attendee, made on the cut-off date. For a block reserved by rooming list the release is one release entry with the cut-off basis on the block ledger, dated the block's cut-off date, which lowers the held room nights by the room nights released and leaves the contracted room nights unchanged.

| Block reserved by | Cut-off release |
|---|---|
| rooming list | one release entry with the cut-off basis, dated the cut-off date, under this policy |
| individual call-in by attendees | every held room night not yet reserved by an attendee, released on the cut-off date |

### What the figure waits on

The room nights released at the cut-off are fixed only after every signed room-night increase addendum on the block has an increase entry on the block ledger naming it.

In other words, as long as a signed room-night increase addendum on the block has no increase entry naming it on the block ledger, the room nights released at the cut-off are not yet fixed.

### Business effect of the release entry

| Item | After the release |
|---|---|
| Held room nights | lower by the room nights released |
| Contracted room nights | unchanged |
| Block ledger | one release entry with the cut-off basis, dated the block's cut-off date |

### Tool: record_cutoff_release_57832b69

**Capability.** Records one release entry on the block's ledger with the cut-off basis, dated the block's cut-off date, for the room nights returned to the hotel's general inventory, and lowers the block's held room nights by that number. The contracted room nights are not changed.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: guest services unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `group_block_id` — the reference number of the group room block whose cut-off release is recorded, as returned by the group block lookup for the organiser's block. Identifier.
- `room_nights_released` — the room nights returned to general inventory by the release. Non-negative integer, whole room nights.

**Return.** On success: `status` "released", `group_entry_id` (reference number of the release ledger entry), `group_block_id`, `room_nights_released`, `held_room_nights` (whole room nights still held after the release) and `entry_date` (the date the release is dated, the block's cut-off date, YYYY-MM-DD).
